messages:
nina: quick check-in on postmortem actions for missing spans + ETL lag + aggregation drift. need owners and explicit pre-deploy checks for the aggregation rollout.

garret: i'll take lead on coordinating rollout. propose checklist: canary 1% telemetry, dashboard smoke, backfill plan signoff.

yvonne: will own instrumentation audit and will run a span-saturation test across staging clusters. target deliverable: audit doc with sample diffs and repro steps by Fri.

ops-bot: created tickets RW-3780 (instrumentation-audit) -> yvonne, RW-3781 (aggregation-rollout) -> garret, RW-3782 (etl-throttled-backfill) -> infra. Links: https://issues.redwood/RW-3780, https://issues.redwood/RW-3781, https://issues.redwood/RW-3782

infra-bot: capacity check: us-east-1 has available window 01:00-07:00 UTC for +3 workers. Please confirm requested windows in RW-3782.

yvonne: found an intermittent leak where trace buffer fails to flush on heavy GC cycles. minimal reproduction: run 4 concurrent clients with burst size >200 and monitor trace queue. PR: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/942 fixes by increasing drain priority on flush.

garret: aggregation fix in staging revealed a subtle ordering-drift when map keys were floats. PR: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/215  normalizes keys to string with canonical formatting.

nina: timeline recap: RW-3780 due 2519950000 (Fri EOD), RW-3781 due 2520030000 (Mon deploy window), RW-3782 plan due 2520100000 (Mon morning).

eng-sre: we'll add a synthetic job to validate span coverage and an alert for ETL lag > 10m and aggregate divergence > 0.15. also will run a smoke test after aggregation deploy to validate no regression.

garret: plan to rollout aggregation fix to staging tonight, run smoke, then canary to 1% traffic next day. if smoke green, proceed to 10% and monitor metrics.

yvonne: also recommending a weekly regression job comparing current aggregation outputs to a golden sample for the most critical queries. adding backlog ticket RW-3800.

infra-bot: RW-3782 window approved: us-east-1 01:00-07:00 UTC next Mon.

nina: thanks everyone. i'll monitor the tickets and we will reconvene in the weekly incidents sync. closing this thread unless any blockers come up. :thumbsup:
